Please refer to the size chart before purchasing and measure your bust, waist, and hips to ensure an accurate fit. Feminine, Flirty Design That Turns Heads: This knee length midi formal evening dress features a sculpted sweetheart neckline, supportive wide straps, an asymmetrical cascading ruffle at the hip, and a high thigh slit for a touch of drama. The curve-hugging bodycon fit and flared side drape accentuate your shape while adding dynamic movement and elegance to every step.

Ruched Design for Tummy Control & Curves: Strategic ruching across the midsection and hips provides gentle compression to flatten the tummy and lift the hips, mimicking the shaping effect of light shapewear. It smooths your silhouette and enhances natural curves for a slimmer, more sculpted look.

Built-In Bra with Premium Stretch Fabric: This cocktail party dress is equipped with a built-in 1/2 cup sponge bra that’s breathable, soft, and supportive—no need for extra lingerie. The fabric is a luxurious blend of 66% polyamide and 34% elastane, offering high stretch, excellent recovery, and a smooth second-skin feel. Wrinkle-resistant and breathable, it ensures all-day comfort while maintaining a flawless fit.

Your Go-To Dress for Every Special Moment: perfect for fall wedding guest dress, formal evening party, cocktail party, birthday, bachelorette party, bridesmaid dress, graduation, homecoming, romantic dinner, date night, Valentine's Day, club wear, holidays, photoshoots, ceremonies, vacations, and more—this dress makes an unforgettable statement.
